mcmansion.e: From Mc- + mansion. First use appears c. 1985.

s.d: (US, derogatory, informal) A large, imposing and ostentatious house that lacks architectural integrity.
x: Twenty mansions were planned for the development, each designed to look like the biggest house in town. The McMansion we thought of as ours had an enormous kitchen, more than two stories high.
After decades of ever-rising square footage in the McMansions that dot the suburbs, the idea of downsizing is gaining champions.
